about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm an informatics engineering student that wasn't really interested in the field before. I have only started making something by myself this year, and it's weirdly enjoyable. I am inherently lazy in a unusual way, so I tend to build things that make my life easier. I currently only have experience with CLIs, but I am learning web development right now.

Outside of school, I am still an indoor person, though I don't usually turn down invitations. I consume a lot of media, mostly video games. Drawing is the hobby I tell people when asked what my hobbies are. I quite enjoy hiking.

items.summary: Own the customer dashboard used by 40,000 logistics teams, from API design through to the interface.
highlights: Rebuilt the dashboard in TypeScript and cut initial load time from 6.2s to 1.9s.
Set up a shared component library now used by five product teams.
Mentor three engineers and run the weekly code review session.

items.summary: Built patient-facing scheduling and messaging features for a telehealth platform.
highlights: Shipped appointment reminders that reduced no-shows by 18%.
Led the move of messaging out of a Rails monolith into its own service.
